findings.comment: The drawing specifies a precision fit (H7) on the ⌀ 4 holes in D1 and applies a coating (I.Z.B.P.) in N3, but fails to specify how the plating thickness is accounted for in the fit or thread preparation. This omission risks assembly failure due to interference from the coating buildup on the mating surfaces.
findings.recommended_correction: Add a note specifying that holes are to be masked during coating, or that they are to be re-machined/reamed after coating to maintain the H7 tolerance, or explicitly state the pre-plate size allowance.
